text:
maya: heads up — dashboard just fired a hosted-usw2 GPU-pool saturation alert, p95 queueing jumped to ~950ms and active queue length ~420. noticed at 10:42 UTC. ops-bot posted stacktrace.

ops-bot: Alert: hosted-usw2/gpu-pool-03 p95_queue_ms=952 queue_len=423 headroom=6% admission_rate=0.84

devin: copying graphs into the thread. looks like a burst from a handful of clients around 10:39 — heavy short-lived generation jobs.

maya: yea, bursty small requests. autoscaler didn't refill fast enough (scale events show failed placement due to fragmentated hosts).

samir: could be fragmentation + strict spread policy. we had a refill last 2h but filler pods didn't pack because of affinity.

henry: can we enable spillover to hosted-eu3 temporarily for overflow? routing rules allow it but we throttle cross-region by default.

devin: spillover is allowed but fallback policy is rate-limited. we can flip the routing flag but watch egress cost.

maya: cost ok for short incident. prefer to open spillover for 15m and monitor. who can flip?

lia: I'll trigger a controlled spillover and bump admission window. opening runbook ticket: RB-3421.

lia: plan: 1) enable eu3 spillover (15m) 2) reduce per-client burst limit from 50->30 for noisy clients 3) evict benign low-priority batch queues 4) monitor p95 for 10m

samir: for longer term we should relax spread or allow bin-packing on late fill to reduce fragmentation. raising as a follow-up.

henry: do we have a quick command to nudge admission? putting it here: 
```
# bump admission threshold from 0.85->0.92
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/admission/config \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n  -d '{"region":"usw2","target_util":0.92}'
```

devin: +1 to that. henry — be careful, do it with canary (single pool) first.

ops-bot: Action log: lia enabled spillover to eu3 at 10:47 UTC, admission target set to 0.92 for hosted-usw2 pool-03 (canary).

maya: after the spillover and admission bump p95 came down to ~320ms within 6 minutes. queue len trending down. nice. :tada:

samir: filing follow-ups: FR-128 fragmentation analysis; OPS-77 autoscaler backoff tuning; COST-55 short-term cross-region egress modeling.

lia: runbook note added and ownership assigned to maya+samir for follow-ups.

henry: for monitoring — can we add a dashboard panel showing "placement fragmentation" (free hosts with partial GPUs) and a ratio metric? would help triage next time.

devin: agreed. i'll add a panel and a low-priority alert for fragmentation > 30% sustained 5m.

maya: thanks all. leaving the temporary overrides off now (15m expired). keeping RB-3421 open until follow-ups done. :thumbsup:
